title: Window Chrome Blocks Canvas Selection
description: Window engagement overlay and measures rail block rectangle selection on canvas play surfaces; clicks on the right trigger browser text selection instead of passing through to the canvas.
summary: Fixed window engagement overlay and measures rail stealing pointer events from canvas selection. Engagement overlay is now pointer-events-none with a narrow top-left hover zone; measures stack is pointer-events-none with pointer-events-auto only on tiles. Added select-none on puzzle canvas container and a regression test.
